identitySignals: ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer lists a registered 501(c)(3) in Stillwater, MN (Cares For Learning, EIN 84-3993176), matching the agenda's 'Stillwater, MN'; the search listing names it 'Cares For Learning - Fluentseeds'
fluentseeds.org's SEEDS of Learning history page lists CARES for Learning and FluentSeeds as past homes of the program, linking the registered nonprofit to the FluentSeeds name

A Collaborative Classroom page says the Kenneth Rainin Foundation partnered with Collaborative Classroom (and formerly FluentSeeds) to build a coaching infrastructure in Oakland Unified School District; Rainin Foundation is also listed among OUSD's funding sources for these contracts
FluentSeeds offers literacy training and coaching for educators, matching OUSD's 'Classroom & academic programs' contracts
research.notes: FluentSeeds merged into Collaborative Classroom in January 2024, so the website now carries merger banners and no standalone contact details; phone, email and address left null. Registered legal name per ProPublica is 'Cares For Learning'; FluentSeeds appears to be its operating name. Agenda lists no California entity.

profile.summary: FluentSeeds was a nonprofit based in Stillwater, Minnesota, that ran SEEDS of Learning, a training and coaching program for educators who work with young children. The program focuses on oral language, early reading and social skills for children ages 3 to 5. In January 2024, FluentSeeds merged into Collaborative Classroom, another education nonprofit.
